caption:
Six rules dictate when your terminal locks.

You configure them before market open. Once live, rules are locked during market hours to stop emotional edits. When any limit breaches, KaatDo cancels every pending order, squares off every position at market, and keeps the account locked until close. If trading activity reappears, the kill switch re-fires.

Every evaluation and broker call is written to a full audit log. Notifications dispatch via Telegram, webhook, and email.
